text_block_list.text: Since Stay Gold hadn't been in good shape lately, we came to the shrine for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... Please let my gaze look softer...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Wah!
Stego-san... and Trainer-san!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear that?
Well, um, I was just a little curious.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah, that look in their eyes when they get mad, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Doesn't this give off kind of a bad impression?
I was worried it might scare the people around me...

"It's probably something that bothers her.
I searched for the right words to somehow comfort her, but..."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You didn't have to.
Though I don't dislike it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Even if you look intimidating,
who you are on the inside hasn't changed, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
“I see...
My heart won't change.”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this was just my own cowardice,
being far too afraid of being misunderstood...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I feel a little more at ease now.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
Well, looking scary isn't the worst thing.
It can even come in handy sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Be of use...?

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Quack! Quack, quack!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Eek! A crow...!?
Uuu, crows are the one thing I just can't deal with...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
C-could it be
that God is angry with us... !?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh? ...I'm kinda in the middle of something right now, though.

Stay Gold turned her back to Narita Top Road
and silently glared at the crow.
The crow flew away in a panic...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, they left...!
But what could have gotten into them so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Who knows?
Maybe God gave you a hand?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to your good deeds every day.
You're just fine the way you are.

"Stay Gold left with a cheerful look.
Strangely enough, from that day on, her condition
completely recovered."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaah!
Something came back!?
Wait, it called its friends...!?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oops.
Did I fire her up too much?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped.
Trainer, take this one and hide.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaahhhhh~~~~!
Ow... ahhhhh....

Stay Gold ran out of the shrine grounds while being pecked by a flock of crows.
Perhaps due to this bad omen, her condition didn't improve.
